text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Tachyon! Anyone but you, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Pokke-kun,
let's not develop tunnel vision, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"When the dragonfly and grasshopper fight,
it's the spider who walks away with the prize."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What!?
Whoa, you guys?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket marked Agnes Tachyon relentlessly. As a result...
another Umamusume snatched the victory away.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *wheeze*... Not funny...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Pokke-kun. However, your running
bears not the slightest resemblance to mine.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well? Did you see anything?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, decent enough.
But... it's still not nearly enough.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Destroying yourself by obsessing over me is pathetic.
Besides, if I don't beat you at your absolute fastest,
I can't call myself the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The real showdown—is next year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Though winning is secondary.
I have yet to reach the level I desire.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Next year, let's do it.
The ultimate experiment: the Fastest vs. the Strongest!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Good work, Pokke.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Fuji-san.
You too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki also came rushing over to reward us for a hard-fought year in the Junior Class.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of the race result.
It looks like the matter with Tsuzuku Raining... really put you through a lot of pain.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's no big deal.
I'm used to it.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
The racing world is ruthless. Did you think I'd forgotten that?
I'm not gonna let it drag me down.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right, Trainer.
On to the next race.
choice_data_list: Next up is the 『Satsuki Sho』, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "‘Satsuki Sho’..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I see. The Satsuki Sho, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: I'm going for the Asahi Hai FS.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I see, you're choosing the mile races.
Then unless I make a surprise entry,
our showdown will have to wait.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that'll have to wait until the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"‘Satsuki Sho’... Even if I go there,
you won't be around anymore, will ya?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Tsuzuki... Oh, Tsuzuki...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: U-Ugh... Uuuuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was that roar out of rage, or sorrow?
A helpless bellow pierced through the night sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Next race: Satsuki Sho.
The curtain rises on a new battle in the Classic tier.
